# spaceman telegram

The Telegram bot's policy and defaults, and a space's Telegram settings (ADR-0083).

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman telegram reset`](#spaceman-telegram-reset) | Reset the bot's policy and defaults to the built-in defaults |
| [`spaceman telegram set`](#spaceman-telegram-set) | Replace the bot's policy and defaults (what isn't given takes its default) |
| [`spaceman telegram set-space`](#spaceman-telegram-set-space) | Set a space's Telegram settings (only the flags given change) |
| [`spaceman telegram settings`](#spaceman-telegram-settings) | The bot's policy and defaults (effective values) |
| [`spaceman telegram space`](#spaceman-telegram-space) | A space's Telegram settings |
| [`spaceman telegram spaces`](#spaceman-telegram-spaces) | Spaces with Telegram settings |
| [`spaceman telegram unset-space`](#spaceman-telegram-unset-space) | Remove a space's Telegram settings (Telegram is off for it again) |

## spaceman telegram reset

Reset the bot's policy and defaults to the built-in defaults.

```sh
spaceman telegram reset [flags]
```

API: `get-telegram-settings`, `delete-telegram-settings` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--yes` | bool |  | confirm: reset the Telegram settings to their defaults |

## spaceman telegram set

Replace the bot's policy and defaults (what isn't given takes its default).

The settings are replaced as a whole: a field neither in --file nor given as a flag takes its built-in default, and only what was given is stored. The send_limits, inbound_limits and notification_defaults blocks are set with --file. The Bot API base URL is not here: it is set only in central's configuration file. Needs system:write and a step-up.

```sh
spaceman telegram set [flags]
```

API: `get-telegram-settings`, `put-telegram-settings` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman telegram set --file telegram.yaml --links-per-user 2
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--init-data-max-age` | integer |  | oldest Mini App initData accepted, 60 to 3600 seconds (default 300) |
| `--link-allow-admin-cap` | bool |  | allow the admin cap on a link at all |
| `--link-code-ttl` | integer |  | link code lifetime in seconds, 120 to 1800 (default 600) |
| `--link-default-max-role` | string |  | cap a new link gets: viewer or operator (default operator) |
| `--link-reconfirm-days` | integer |  | days until a link must be confirmed again, 7 to 365 (default 90) |
| `--link-sso-grants` | bool |  | a link confirmed from an SSO session also carries the SSO-mapped grants, until that session ends |
| `--links-per-user` | integer |  | Telegram accounts per user, 1 to 3 (default 1) |
| `--miniapp-session-absolute` | integer |  | Mini App session lifetime, 900 to 43200 seconds (default 3600) |
| `--miniapp-session-idle` | integer |  | Mini App session idle timeout, 300 to 3600 seconds (default 900) |
| `--topics-mode-default` | bool |  | new links start in topics mode |

## spaceman telegram set-space

Set a space's Telegram settings (only the flags given change).

A space is invisible to Telegram until enabled. Needs space_config:write in the space and a step-up.

```sh
spaceman telegram set-space [flags]
```

API: `get-space-telegram`, `put-space-telegram` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman telegram set-space --space payments --enabled --content-level summary
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--content-level` | string |  | full, summary or off (default full) |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | make the space visible through Telegram |
| `--enforced-approvals` | string |  | web_only or confirm (default web_only) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--terminal-watch` | bool |  | allow watching run terminals (read-only) from the Mini App |
| `--topics` | bool |  | give the space its own topic for users in topics mode |
